steps.en: Install the skill, then its Node dependencies and Chromium once
steps.zh: 安装技能，再装一次 Node 依赖和 Chromium

steps.en: Ask for a machine, with a reference and real dimensions if you have them
steps.zh: 说出要的机器，有参考图和真实尺寸就一起给

steps.en: Copy the closest example and write kinematics, parts, panels and tour
steps.zh: 照最接近的示例写运动学、零件、面板和导览

steps.en: Bundle one offline HTML page and check still sheets until clean
steps.zh: 打包成一个离线网页，反复看截图拼图直到无误

steps.en: Render a 60 fps MP4 with a score on the same timeline
steps.zh: 逐帧渲染 60 帧 MP4，配上同一时间线的音效

value.en: A take-apart 3D page and film designed to share motion and readout calculations
value.zh: 得到可拆解 3D 网页和影片，按规则共享动作与读数计算
